species.real: Tristan's lobster fishery carries the Marine Stewardship Council's label for sustainable fishing, and on an island this remote, whether boats go out at all depends on the weather that morning.
species.name: Crawfisher

dex.text: Red as a postbox and about as willing to be moved. Spends the season in the cold deep and the rest of the year in a pot, a tin and the island economy.
dex.fact: The Tristan rock lobster is the island's main export, and Tristan has no airstrip: the only way in is by ship from Cape Town, a voyage of around six days.
